items.why: The fear gauge jumps as stocks turn lower with chip names leading the slide.
Chip stocks are tumbling across the board, dragging AMD down with the sector.
Nvidia slides and gives back part of Monday's rally, when it surged on Jensen Huang's return as CEO.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures down about 1% and Nasdaq futures down nearly 2%.
summary: Stocks are lower early Tuesday, giving back part of Monday's rally as chip stocks tumble and Nvidia slides. The VIX is jumping while the Dow holds near flat.
